No Unknown constructor -- an absent or unparseable observation DENOTES Fail, so fail-closed is a theorem about the absorbing element rather than a per-call-site discipline.

entropy_metric_correction.mandate: Operator (2026-09-09): "fix the entropy floor and delete the broken node-22 tree".
entropy_metric_correction.finding: KMP-ENTROPY was NOT a corpus defect. Km_metrics.layer_entropy_bits folded over Km_corpus.layer, which is the FIRST #fractal-lN tag in a record. Records are multi-label -- 47 of 80 ADRs carry all ten layers, only 6 carry as few as two -- and the tag block is written ascending by convention, so the first tag was #fractal-l0 for 74 of 80 records. The statistic measured the writing convention and discarded roughly 90% of the labelling.
entropy_metric_correction.measurement: first-tag entropy 1.322 bits; all-tag entropy 3.309 bits against a ceiling of log2(10) = 3.322.
entropy_metric_correction.fix: Km_corpus.adr gained a `layers` field (all distinct tags, ascending) and layer_entropy_bits now folds over every tag. The `layer` field is retained for its other consumers.
entropy_metric_correction.floor_unchanged: The 2.50 floor was NOT moved. Correcting a metric is only legitimate if the threshold survives the correction, and law E5 proves the corrected metric still fails a genuinely degenerate corpus (all-l0 -> 0 bits) and E6 that a two-layer corpus stays below 2.50.
entropy_metric_correction.law_suite: km_gate --metrics-selftest: 8 laws, 8/8 pass. E4 pins the multi-label behaviour; E8 pins order-independence, which the old metric lacked.
entropy_metric_correction.collateral: Km_layers (the cosine layer classifier) was built ON THIS FALSE PREMISE. Its header now records that. Applying every one of its proposals would have reached only 2.21 bits -- still below the floor it was built to clear -- while rewriting 58 records of which 35 were explicitly low-margin. No proposal was applied: chasing a broken metric would have damaged the corpus to satisfy a statistic about tag ordering.
entropy_metric_correction.result: tools/km-gate status PASS, 0 findings, entropy 3.309 bits.
